title: Accelerate additional cost [1][fury] is not charged; paying Accelerate is free
expected: ven.json ven-016-166 (line ~753) Accelerate ability is `{keyword:"Accelerate",type:"keyword"}` with no `cost` — it is the only Accelerate ability across all set JSONs missing one (script check: ogn/sfd/unl all carry cost). adaptJsonCard (all-cards.ts:807-809) passes the non-empty abilities through and enrichCard (enrich-cards.ts:23) skips re-parsing when abilities are defined, so no cost is recovered from rulesText. getOptionalPlayCost (cost.ts:763-765) returns `{cost: undefined, kind:"accelerate"}`, and resolvePayableOptionalCost (play-unit.ts:87) maps that to `{energy: optional.cost?.energy ?? 0, power: optional.cost?.power ?? []}` = {0, []}. So Accelerate charges nothing extra yet paidAccelerate still makes the unit enter ready.
observed: With energy 20 / fury 4, playing via the Accelerate variant (playUnit paidAdditionalCost:true) left energy 12 / fury 4 (only base 8 energy paid, 0 fury) and the unit entered ready. The enumerated move carries additionalCostSpec {energy:0,power:[]}. Root cause: ven.json ability {keyword:'Accelerate',type:'keyword'} has no `cost` field (every other Accelerate card in sfd/unl has cost:{energy:1,power:[domain]}), and getOptionalPlayCost reads ability.cost -> undefined -> 0.
